scope: Quickcheck routing and bounded controller compilation with repaired owned-process-group cleanup; local host-tooling acceptance only.

failure_dispositions: Original material cleanup failure is closed by source review and meaningful two-platform negative controls.
Initial Linux parent-read ownership error received one exact-lane bounded retry; matching passing suite was reused.
Saved logs strip trailing whitespace only. Raw stream hashes remain provenance metadata; raw streams are not retained for recomputation. Assertions/outcomes are unchanged.
Independent Test verifier initially counted assertion source text; it was corrected to count lines beginning AssertionError. Initial verifier log retained; no production or fixture change.

Stage4 verifier initially treated older build-work-stage3 manifest keys as repository-relative. Corrected resolution to each manifest directory for keys without evidence/ prefix. Initial verifier log and command/hash record retained. Corrected identity check PASS; no production, fixture or prior evidence changed.
limits: Matching executed checks were reused under rule9: seven-method macOS and pinned Linux controller suites, ten exact-parent rejection subcases per platform, six unaffected suites and prior independent Quickcheck checks. No new behavior suite or scratch behavior probe was needed.
The original controller fixture PASS is superseded by repaired seven-method platform checks. Historical bug-expected cleanup probes remain failure evidence and were not run against the repair.

Six original-source signal negative controls fail before signal delivery, at the earlier-child-stopped assertion. Repaired passing cases deliver HUP/INT/TERM and verify statuses129/130/143 and cleanup.
Normalised saved logs match their hashes. Pre-normalisation raw digests are retained provenance metadata; raw streams are unavailable for recomputation.
SDK/toolchain full hashes are reused from saved validated records; proprietary dependencies were not rehashed or bundled.
One prior real controller build is reused. Its 28.513924458 seconds is a single measured build, without an isolated or end-to-end speedup claim.
Direct fixture runner registration remains with the runner/combination owner. Fixed-tree devbug reuse stays deferred; fixed regression rerun and parent negative control remain required.
This is scoped host-tooling acceptance. It does not establish combined-tooling acceptance, firmware integration, release/full-gate, installation or device PASS.
